Subject: Discovery recap & next steps - rotating demo slots

Hi Liam / Sarah -

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: We covered your primary goals (reduce inference cost, standardize inference across cloud regions, and set SLOs for latency). Key constraints were PCI-adjacent data flows and a desire to trial both Hosted and Dedicated modes.
- Ask: Schedule a technical deep-dive/demo with your infra and ML engineers to walk through our routing, batching, and quantization recommendations.

Given the distributed nature of your team (US, EU, APAC), we recommend starting with a rotating recurring time slot so each region gets one session at a convenient local time on a regular cadence. Below are three proposed rotating templates (times shown in local zones):

Option A - US-first week (rotate weekly)
  - Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 AM ET / Tue 3:00 PM BST / Wed 11:00 PM AEST
  - Week 2 (EMEA-friendly): Wed 11:00 AM CET / Wed 2:00 AM PDT / Wed 7:00 PM AEST
  - Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Thu 9:00 AM AEST / Wed 5:00 PM PT / Thu 11:00 AM CEST

Option B - Fixed rotating times (same UTC anchor)
  - Week 1: 15:00 UTC (US morning / EU afternoon)
  - Week 2: 02:00 UTC (APAC morning / US evening)
  - Week 3: 09:00 UTC (EU morning / US late night)

Option C - Biweekly alternating (US/EU one week, APAC the next)

Please let me know which option looks best and share any blackout dates. If you prefer, suggest three concrete slots in your local time and I'll convert and propose a recurring invite that rotates between regions.

Attached: Discovery_Agenda_Acme.pdf (draft agenda).

Best,
Camila Reyes
